answer: Each identity must forge a forecast record in its vault, locking an 80-credit bond and posting key-signed forecasts on ten events before outcomes are known, and falcon auditors score records after outcomes land, granting weight only for seven-plus correct calls, and burning any duplicate vector's bond. Each costs 10 credits per event, so the k-th fake pays 180 credits, 100 in fees plus 80 locked, and 1,000 fakes cost 180,000 credits. A copied-forecast ring fails: late copies miss the timestamp, and early copies share one vector and burn both bonds. An honest agent builds one record once.
